message.villagelaw.reported: %1$s: a guard saw that and is coming to you. The fine stands at %2$s emeralds.
message.villagelaw.short: %1$s's fine is %2$s emeralds, and you carry %3$s.
message.villagelaw.leave: Leave %1$s within %2$s seconds, and stay away for %3$s days.
message.villagelaw.hostile: You stayed in %1$s. Its guards are coming for you.
message.villagelaw.banished: You are banished from %1$s for %2$s days and owe it %3$s emeralds. Its guards attack you there until then.
message.villagelaw.debt: Your banishment from %1$s is over. You still owe it %2$s emeralds: pay any of its guards.

screen.villagelaw.debt.body: You owe this village %1$s emeralds for %2$s. Pay, and the matter is closed.
